description: This file appears to be a C header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes related to managing branches in a version control system (likely Git). It includes functions for creating branches, setting tracking modes, validating branch names, and handling branch checkout states.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets branch tracking configuration for a new reference, establishing how it tracks an upstream reference based on tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository with various options including start point, force overwrite, reflog creation, and tracking configuration.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository and recursively in its submodules, based on a specified commit or ref.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where the specified branch is currently checked out, if any.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates a branch name and returns whether it exists, filling the ref buffer.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates if a new branch name can be created, considering force option, and fills the ref buffer.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge-related state information from the repository.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information related to the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Configures a local branch to track a remote branch, used primarily by git branch --set-upstream.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description of a branch into a strbuf.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Checks if a branch is checked out in any worktree and terminates the program if it is.
